message.content:
The root cause is that the code attempts to print a column named `'treatment_rate - control_rate'` which does not exist in the DataFrame after the merge — the difference was computed as a separate Series, not stored in the merged DataFrame. This error occurs because the subtraction was performed on the Series `combined['treatment_rate'] - combined['control_rate']`, but the resulting difference was not assigned to a column in the DataFrame.

Here is the corrected and final submission:
